- SCCs: based on the way you describe the relationship (Acme sets the purposes/means and Redwood processes on your behalf), the typical route is Controller-to-Processor SCCs (we generally recommend Module 2 / Controller-to-Processor clauses for this pattern). We'll confirm with legal.

Next steps I recommend:
1) I'll attach our DPA template and SCC guidance for your legal team to review.
2) Marissa (privacy) / Neha (security) will follow up with any supporting artifacts and to kickoff the vendor questionnaire.
3) Please confirm you expect Redwood to act as processor (vs controller) so we can lock SCC module selection.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.pdf (attached)

Thanks  happy to jump on a short call with your legal/security if useful.

2) SCC module selection: Our legal recommends the Controller-to-Processor module as the correct fit. I'll attach our SCC guidance and the SCC_Matrix.xlsx that maps modules to common customer scenarios. If you prefer, we can mark the relevant clause set in the DPA before routing to your counsel.

3) SOC 2: we started the Type II audit in April; fieldwork is in progress and we're targeting completion of the report (Type II) in Q3 2027. In the interim we can share SOC 2 Type I evidence and our security controls description. Security will respond with questionnaire kickoff.

Attachments: Redwood_SCC_Selection_Guidance.pdf, SCC_Matrix.xlsx

- Rishi: send the DPA template with the Controller-to-Processor SCC module selected (I'll review redlines).
- Acme legal: send the vendor questionnaire link or PDF and any data-flow diagrams that would be helpful.
- Security (Neha): I'll coordinate the evidence pack for SOC 2 Type I and any available interim artifacts.
